d:
Deepa Bhasthi reveals the "why" behind the stories she chose to translate. She dives into the recurring themes of obsession, insanity, and death that haunt these characters, and how she curated a collection that tracks the impact of patriarchy across every stage of a woman’s life—from childhood to widowhood.
Deepa also addresses the "Sholay Problem": the difficulty of translating stories so deeply rooted in local folklore that they lose their magic in English.
Thank you for watching our video!
